statement.zh: 凤雏三号基址庭院为西周「社宫」国家级祭祀场所——属简报作者解释，不作唯一定论。
statement.en: That Fengchu Foundation No. 3 courtyard is a Western Zhou state-level "she palace" shrine is the brief authors' interpretation — not a sole verdict.
